subject: Mid-cycle seat swap + temporary tax hold while VAT is validated
messages:
From: Jennifer Kloss <jennifer.kloss@lyrahealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: accounts-payable@lyrahealth.com
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: mid-cycle seat swap and tax hold while we validate VAT ID

Hi Priya,

We need to move 12 seats from our Staging pool to Production effective 2026-09-30. Because this is mid-billing cycle, can you please:

- Apply proration so we are only charged for the remainder of the month on the 12-seat increase,
- Hold charging VAT until we confirm Lyra's EU VAT ID on file (we are still getting it validated internally), and
- Provide a proforma showing the prorated charge + a note that VAT will be applied once ID is confirmed.

I've attached a short request form and the account contact for AP. If you need a signed amendment, say so and we'll get it from Legal.

Thanks,
Jennifer
Senior Finance Manager
Lyra Health
Attachment: Lyra_Billing_Change_Request.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Jennifer Kloss <jennifer.kloss@lyrahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: mid-cycle seat swap and tax hold while we validate VAT ID

Hi Jennifer — thanks for the note and attaching the form. We're able to do a mid-cycle seat increase with a prorated invoice for the remainder of the month. A few quick confirmations so our billing team can process this:

1) Confirm the effective date is 2026-09-30 (you indicated this; we'll use it to calculate partial-month days).
2) Will the seats be permanent or temporary through the next billing cycle? (this affects proforma vs. amendment language).
3) Please forward the VAT ID once validated to accounts-payable so we can trigger reverse-charge handling / VAT removal if applicable.

I'll coordinate with Finance to produce a proforma and place a temporary VAT hold so we don't auto-bill VAT until you give the green light. If AP prefers a signed amendment for the seat move, let me know and I'll route it through Legal.

Next steps: I'll loop in our billing ops and tax point people and follow up with a proforma by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Lead, Mid-Market Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Lyra Health — mid-cycle seat increase (proration + temporary VAT hold)

Team — forwarding Lyra's request. Key asks: mid-cycle add of +12 seats effective 2026-09-30, prorated charge for remainder of Sep 2026, and a temporary hold on VAT until they provide validated EU VAT ID. They prefer a proforma rather than a signed amendment if possible.

Can you please:
- Confirm proration calculation method (we typically pro-rate by days in billing period; confirm rounding rules),
- Generate a proforma that shows: base prorated seat charge, tax line item flagged as "On hold — pending VAT ID", and an explanatory note about VAT application after validation,
- Temporarily mark auto-taxing off for this account (region: US but tax hold requested), and
- If we need a manual credit or ledger hold to prevent VAT being invoiced on 2026-09-30, let me know exact GL/credit action.

I've attached their request PDF. Invoice/charge will be small (rough estimate included in the attached). If this triggers any revenue recognition or billing policy exceptions, flag them.

Thanks — Priya

Attachment: Lyra_Billing_Change_Request.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Lyra Health — mid-cycle seat increase (proration + temporary VAT hold)

Priya / team — confirmed. Notes below and next steps for ops: 

1) Proration approach: pro-rate by actual days remaining in the customer's billing month (Sep 30 included as effective, so charge = (days_remaining/30) * monthly per-seat rate). We round to cents.

2) Proforma: attached RDW_proforma_seat-swap_20260930.pdf. It includes:
   - Line A: 12 seats prorated 1 day (2026-09-30) and remainder of month calculation,
   - Line B: Current monthly subscription (unchanged),
   - Tax line: "VAT — pending validation" with zero amount; explanatory note: "VAT will be applied retroactively if required once Lyra provides valid VAT ID and tax residency evidence."

3) Tax hold: I've placed a temporary tax-exempt flag on the account for the upcoming cycle. This prevents the system from auto-applying VAT on the proforma. Billing will NOT auto-post VAT until AP provides the confirmed VAT ID. Once we receive it, ops will:
   - Recompute tax for the proforma/charge,
   - Issue an updated invoice (or credit + charge) and notify Lyra AP,
   - In cases where VAT gets applied retroactively, we will create a tax-only invoice with clear reconciliation lines.

4) GL action: No manual credit is needed if the tax-exempt flag is set. If legal requires a signed amendment, we can attach it to the customer record; not necessary to prevent VAT today.

5) Follow-up: Priya, please confirm whether the 12 seats are permanent. If temporary, indicate end date. Jennifer/AP, once you send the VAT ID we'll re-open tax calculation.

Attaching proforma now. I'll also update HubSpot (LYRA-5234) with the proforma link and set a task for AP reconciliation.

Marissa Cole
Billing Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachment: RDW_proforma_seat-swap_20260930.pdf (application/pdf)
